analysis: The only change in docs/reference/configuration.md is documentation. Head lines 5-7 reword the intro to drop the "retained-console" scope and the "Console UI" section is removed (base lines 81-99). Head text shows no new settings, defaults, environment variables, or code paths. The removal of console build-time variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) from this reference narrows documented scope. It does not alter provider behavior, coordinator-to-provider WebSocket handling (TB-002), attestation (TB-009/TB-011), or the prefix-cache posture (T-041). The remaining provider-owned content was left unchanged by the diff: GLM qualification env, add-on hold (TB-012/T-059/T-060), endpoint resumption and logout (A-008), the worker qualification flags, and cache location. None of it is modified, so I found no regression or invalidated threat-model assumption. One unverified contract: whether the console-ui was actually removed or relocated elsewhere in this PR. That is outside the supplied evidence, and only the doc-side removal is visible. Line 7 of the head text points the reader to the platform configuration reference, which is an immutable link and not a claim about current behavior. The doc claims about security-relevant defaults, for example that DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 disables the SSD prefix cache, are pre-existing and unchanged. No threat-model update appears needed from this change alone. I did not review code behind the cited symbols.
